# Command Training Manual ### CMD-00
[color=green]BY ORDER OF THE CENTRAL COMMAND [color=green]DEPARTMENT OF CENSURE This file is Level [color=#1b67a5]COMMAND[/color] classified, Unauthorized access is forbidden.
=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=
# Foreword
If you are reading this manual, then one of two things has occurred.
You have either been assigned to a command position aboard a NanoTrasen station, or you have demonstrated the aptitude necessary to be entrusted with one.
Congratulations.
Before continuing, understand that this manual is not introductory reading. It is not intended to teach you how to wear your uniform, complete paperwork, or manage departmental budgets. This document exists to prepare you for the aspects of command that cannot be discussed openly, cannot be taught in ocupational training, and cannot appear in standard operating procedures.
Everything beyond this page has been classified under corporate authority.
By opening this manual, you acknowledge that you have executed Non-Disclosure Agreement NT-NDA-3.8, including all supplemental security clauses, extraordinary confidentiality provisions, and terminal enforcement articles. You are already aware of the legal, financial, and personal consequences of unauthorized disclosure.
No further reminders will be provided.
The information contained within this manual may conflict with your previous education, professional experience, or understanding of accepted scientific principles.
Certain sections may appear implausible. Others may appear internally inconsistent or contrary to established corporate doctrine. Such reactions are anticipated and have been documented among command personnel.
These reactions are not evidence that the material is inaccurate.
The Corporation does not require command personnel to accept these subjects without scrutiny. It requires that they recognize, evaluate, and respond to them when operational circumstances demand it.
Failure to do so has resulted in the loss of stations, assets, research programs, and personnel.
As a Command Officer, your responsibilities extend beyond the administration of departments and the welfare of assigned personnel.
You are entrusted with the continuity of station operations during incidents for which the majority of employees possess neither the clearance nor the contextual knowledge to understand. In such circumstances, the preservation of classified information may be inseparable from the preservation of the station itself.
You may be required to issue orders without explanation.
You may be required to withhold accurate information from personnel acting in good faith.
You may be required to make decisions based upon information that cannot be entered into official reports or discussed outside authorized channels.
These responsibilities are inherent to command authority and should not be interpreted as exceptional.
This manual does not attempt to prepare you for every contingency. No document can.
Its purpose is to establish a foundation from which informed judgment may be exercised when established doctrine proves insufficient.
The effectiveness of a Command Officer is measured not by familiarity with routine operations, but by the ability to preserve order when confronted with circumstances outside ordinary expectation.
Read this manual thoroughly.
Retain its contents.
Apply its guidance without hesitation when required.
Your authority began upon assuming command.
Your responsibility begins now.
# Recorded Threats
The following are threats we have records of that are deemed possible to appear within your assigned sector.
## The Syndicate
The Syndicate is a conglomeration of personnel drawn from the upper echelons of numerous hostile organizations. These organizations include rival corporations such as Interdyne and CyberSun, ideological groups including the Animal Rights Consortium, and organized raider organizations such as the Gorlax Marauders.
### Undercover Syndicate Agents
These organizations most commonly deploy covert operatives with diverse objectives and an even wider array of equipment.
Command personnel should therefore assume nothing regarding an operative's capabilities.
For known operational targets and recovered equipment, refer to [textlink="Section █.██" link="Traitors"].
### Nuclear Operatives
On rare occasions, stations may be targeted by Nuclear Operatives.
While public-facing corporate policy continues to dismiss such reports as fictional entertainment, these operatives are real.
They are elite terrorists recruited primarily from organized raider groups and are tasked with the total destruction of NanoTrasen stationss through nuclear detonation.
Do not allow them to succeed.
Standard equipment profiles and tactical assessments are available in [textlink="Section █.██" link="NuclearOperatives"].
### Zombies
The zombie pathogen has been employed by Syndicate forces through contaminated cargo, infected personnel, and during Nuclear Operative assaults.
The threat is genuine.
Infected personnel will succumb to the pathogen within minutes if untreated.
Stations experiencing confirmed outbreaks should immediately implement quarantine procedures while Medical develops or synthesizes Ambuzol.
Upon death, infected individuals become highly aggressive vectors whose sole objective is the spread of infection.
Further information regarding the pathogen and approved treatment protocols is available in [textlink="Section █.██" link="Zombies"].
## Religions, Cults, and Magic
As NanoTrasen's expansion into Bluespace continues, personnel occasionally encounter phenomena beyond accepted scientific understanding.
These incidents must be documented carefully.
Command personnel are expected to verify anomalous activity, maintain operational discipline, and respond cautiously.
Poor judgment during such events has resulted in catastrophic sector-wide losses.
### Cosmic Cult
One of the most thoroughly documented consequences of prolonged Bluespace interaction concerns an entity historically designated only as "the Unknown."
Although official records available to the public dismiss such accounts as myth, classified investigation confirms the phenomenon's existence.
Individuals who uncover fragments of its nature frequently develop obsessive behavior and seek to facilitate its arrival.
These groups are designated Cosmic Cults.
Historical incident reports are maintained within Section █.██.
### Xenoborgs
It remains unknown whether standard cyborg designs predate these autonomous constructs or were derived from them.
Their systems appear powered by crystalline energy believed to originate from Bluespace.
This grants capabilities substantially exceeding those of conventional NanoTrasen cyborgs.
Their observed objective is the acquisition of intelligent life, its integration beneath a unified law structure, and eventual incorporation into a larger collective directed from an unidentified mothership.
Known Xenoborg classifications are catalogued in [textlink="Section █.██" link="Xenoborgs"].
## Other Threats
### Thieves
While light thievery is not uncommon even upon our own stations, sometimes more skilled personnel are discovered operating black market enterprises aboard NanoTrasen facilities.
When apprehended, these personnel are provided with a pacification implant, permanently recorded within corporate records, and released following completion of their sentence.
To determine whether an individual possesses one of these implants, submit Form NT-REC-512.124 through the appropriate records request process.
Additional intelligence regarding recovered equipment and historical operations can be found in [textlink="Section █.██" link="Thieves"].
